name: mcon_list_contacts
description: List the account's contacts (summaries), sorted by name. Optional `q` filters by name/organization/nickname (substring); optional `tag` filters to contacts carrying that tag; `sort` may be 'name' (default) or 'recent'. Each summary has: slug, display_name, nickname, organization, tags, birth_month, birth_day, photo_updated_at, updated_at. Use this to find a contact's `slug` before mcon_get_contact / mcon_update_contact / mcon_delete_contact. For a broader full-text lookup use mcon_search.

q.description: Optional name/organization/nickname substring filter. Omit for all.

tag.description: Optional tag to filter by (exact). Omit for all.
